cases.purpose: Assert both freeze spellings, independent EBUSY and blocked-write oracles, thaw and failure-path cleanup on a disposable ext4 loop mount.
cases.oracle: util-linux fsfreeze with C-locale EBUSY diagnostic and a bounded writer
cases.comparison: Both sides must complete all assertions with the same output and status; setup and cleanup failures are failures.
cases.script:
export LC_ALL=C
D=$(/usr/bin/mktemp -d /tmp/fsfreeze-regression.XXXXXXXX) || exit 90
M=$D/mnt
dev=
mounted=0
cleanup() {
  local rc=$?
  trap - EXIT
  if (( mounted )); then
    /usr/sbin/fsfreeze -u "$M" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
    if /usr/bin/umount "$M"; then mounted=0; else rc=91; fi
  fi
  if [[ -n $dev ]]; then /usr/sbin/losetup -d "$dev" || rc=92; fi
  if (( ! mounted )); then /usr/bin/rm -rf "$D" || rc=93; fi
  exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
fail() { printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
/usr/bin/mkdir "$M" || exit 90
/usr/bin/truncate -s 8M "$D/image" || exit 90
/usr/sbin/mkfs.ext4 -q -F -O ^has_journal -E nodiscard,lazy_itable_init=0 "$D/image" || exit 90
dev=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -f --show "$D/image") || exit 90
/usr/bin/mount "$dev" "$M" || exit 90
mounted=1
printf data > "$M/read" || exit 90
silent() {
  "$@" >"$D/out" 2>"$D/err" || fail "$1 $2 failed"
  [[ ! -s $D/out && ! -s $D/err ]] || fail "$1 $2 produced output"
}
busy() {
  /usr/sbin/fsfreeze -f "$M" >"$D/probe.out" 2>"$D/probe.err" && fail 'probe unexpectedly froze filesystem'
  [[ ! -s $D/probe.out ]] || fail 'probe stdout'
  /usr/bin/grep -Fq 'Device or resource busy' "$D/probe.err" || fail 'probe failed for reason other than EBUSY'
}
for flag in -f --freeze; do
  silent fsfreeze "$flag" "$M"
  busy
  [[ $(/usr/bin/cat "$M/read") == data ]] || fail 'read during freeze'
  /usr/bin/timeout 8 /usr/bin/dd if=/dev/zero of="$M/write" bs=4096 count=2 conv=fsync status=none >"$D/wout" 2>"$D/werr" &
  writer=$!
  /usr/bin/sleep 1
  kill -0 "$writer" 2>/dev/null || fail 'writer did not block'
  if [[ $flag == -f ]]; then thaw=-u; else thaw=--unfreeze; fi
  silent fsfreeze "$thaw" "$M"
  wait "$writer" || fail 'writer did not resume'
  [[ $(/usr/bin/stat -c %s "$M/write") == 8192 ]] || fail 'wrong write size'
done
# Simulate an assertion failure while frozen. The nested EXIT trap must thaw.
(
  trap '/usr/sbin/fsfreeze -u "$M" >/dev/null 2>&1' EXIT
  silent fsfreeze -f "$M"
  busy
  exit 42
)
[[ $? == 42 ]] || fail 'simulated assertion failure did not propagate'
# A successful independent freeze proves the failure path thawed the mount.
/usr/sbin/fsfreeze -f "$M" >"$D/probe.out" 2>"$D/probe.err" || fail 'cleanup left filesystem frozen'
/usr/sbin/fsfreeze -u "$M" >"$D/probe.out" 2>"$D/probe.err" || fail 'final probe thaw failed'
printf 'freeze lifecycle and failure cleanup verified\n'
cases.stdout: freeze lifecycle and failure cleanup verified
